title: Lamb and Turkish Pilaf Stir-Fry
description: A fusion of Chinese and Turkish flavors in a delicious and quick stir-fry. The lamb and pilaf add a hearty and nutty taste to this dish.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of sesame oil to the skillet.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked Turkish pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf and vegetables.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
